blocks.text: Star Magic has called for an end to online harassment directed at its 13-year-old artist, Michelle Garcia, following an interview with her father, Patrick Garcia, about his past with Jennylyn Mercado. In a statement posted on its social media pages on Thursday, Oct. 1, Star Magic said it was “deeply concerned” about the comments directed at Michelle. “Star Magic is deeply concerned about the hurtful comments directed at our artist, Michelle Garcia, who is only 13 years old,” the talent management arm of ABS-CBN said. “We ask the public to refrain from involving Michelle in matters concerning adults that happened before […]...
